notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed some typos
[*] Fixed not being able to see typing minigame behind Aya sprite, now appears in front
[*] Fixed some sprite errors, eg. Katsumi being too big
[*] Fixed being able to use Pause menu during splash screen when opening game
[*] Fixed being unable to replay the prologue/School Episode 1 without soft-locking yourself via points
[/list]

This was just a quick bug fix update, I will be working on the content update coming later this month. See you soon.

notes.title: Demo update 1.2
notes.content:
Hey hey!
Today I'm adding a couple of minor changes to the demo which are mostly quality of life improvements.

[list]
[*] Clearer instructions on how the Charging/Intensity mechanic works
[*] Better phrasing on some question prompts (The sports club one)
[*] A special scene for when you input a secret input in an area. (Yeah, I know, super vague but you should find out yourself what I'm talking about!)
[/list]

That's it for now! I probably won't update the demo again, unless it's for minor optimizations which won't be documented but I'll still be posting updates on progress of the full game!

Also make sure you check out our currently on-going Kickstarter and support us! You can [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/studiotsundere/i-just-want-to-be-single/]find it here[/url]. Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.1
notes.content:
Updated the demo to version 1.1

In this update, I:

[list]
[*] Optimized performance in parts where it lagged a bit before, so you should be getting a smoother experience.
[*] Sections where you need to remember details for a star are more forgiving now (especially the sports one)
[*] Fixed a few typos.
[*] Dynamic capitalization for lazy people who don't use proper punctuation for their inputs kek (basically the game will correctly capitalize your words for you)
[*] Disabled Renpy's default accessibility menu which sometimes gets accidentally shown by pressing the 'A' key.
[*] The infamous "ascended" bug where sprites become glowy white should occur less now.
[/list]


[h2]If you have a bug to report, feel free to drop by our discord server! (we have dank memes)[/h2]

[url=https://discord.gg/tsunderestudio]https://discord.gg/tsunderestudio[/url]
